title: Add per-target live emotions, persona habit/quirk tell hooks, and flustered volume slip to emotion prototypes
goal: Align the emotion prototypes with VirtualWorld's existing multi-target affect, persona habits/quirks, and involuntary speech layers before running multi-actor live proofs.

sections.what: Upgrade prototypes/emotions/ with per-target live emotions/episodes, character-specific involuntary tell hooks reading existing persona habits/quirks, and involuntary flustered volume slip (whisper -> normal) aligned with VirtualWorld's existing mind and involuntary layers.
sections.why: Three prototype gaps block realistic multi-character live stress tests: (1) CharacterEmotionState.families (prototypes/emotions/schema.py:703) is a single flat global map, whereas production player.py:828 (felt_toward) and bug-596 support multi-target feelings; (2) render_observer_tells (prototypes/emotions/autonomic.py:406-510) emits only generic human tells instead of reading existing persona.personality habits/quirks (engine/character_appearance.py:148-149); and (3) render_vocal_interruption (prototypes/emotions/autonomic.py:513-556) handles stutters/voice catches but not involuntary volume slips when a flustered character fails to keep their voice down.
sections.how:
1. Add target_name: Optional[str] on EpisodeRecord and target_families: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] on CharacterEmotionState in prototypes/emotions/schema.py (lines 670-713), updated by apply_matrix_step in prototypes/emotions/coupling.py and rendered into Track 1/Track 2 context (mirroring Player.felt_toward in player.py:828-865 and bug-596's multi-target schema).
2. Extend render_own_body_prompt and render_observer_tells in prototypes/emotions/autonomic.py (lines 300-510) to read character habits and quirks from existing persona/player fields (engine/character_appearance.py PERSONALITY_FIELDS lines 148-149) so personal involuntary tells surface alongside generic autonomic cues when stress/fluster thresholds fire.
3. Add a compute_involuntary_volume_slip helper in prototypes/emotions/autonomic.py alongside render_vocal_interruption (lines 513-556) to raise whisper -> normal when autonomic arousal exceeds regulation capacity on impulsive/nervous traits (reusing the NERVOUS_TRAITS vocabulary in static/js/agent/involuntary.ts:50).
4. Add unit tests in prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py covering all three behaviors.
sections.verify: Run pytest prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py -v and verify multi-target contrasting emotions, personal habit/quirk tells, and flustered volume slip all pass cleanly.

acceptance.text: CharacterEmotionState in prototypes/emotions/schema.py tracks per-target live emotion overlays (target_families) and target_name on EpisodeRecord, updated in coupling.py and surfaced to Track 1/Track 2 prompts so contrasting emotions toward different people stay distinct per target rather than collapsing into one global axis.

render_own_body_prompt and render_observer_tells in prototypes/emotions/autonomic.py read character-specific habits/quirks from existing persona/player data (matching engine/character_appearance.py PERSONALITY_FIELDS) when autonomic stress/fluster thresholds fire.

A new compute_involuntary_volume_slip helper in prototypes/emotions/autonomic.py models flustered volume slips (whisper -> normal) when arousal/autonomic overload exceeds regulation capacity for impulsive/jittery traits (aligned with static/js/agent/involuntary.ts NERVOUS_TRAITS).
pytest prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py covers multi-target contrasting emotions, persona habit/quirk tell rendering, and flustered volume slip.

custom.browser_ui: In prototypes/emotions/lab_app.py (Emotion Lab UI), display active per-target emotion badges alongside global families and show personal tell cues and any involuntary volume slip in the step trace panel. Manual check: trigger a multi-target event (protective fear for person A, guilt toward person B, anger at person C) and confirm each target displays distinct live emotions without flattening.

evidence: pytest tests/test_speech_tone.py tests/test_sound.py tests/test_spatial_invariants.py prototypes/emotions/test_prototypes.py: 100 passed in 8.93s (including test_task997_per_target_emotions_persona_tells_and_volume_slip).
prototypes/emotions/lab_app.py displays Per-Target Live Feelings alongside 13-Family Matrix and 8-Channel Autonomic Body.
